result.title: CARE-WM: Same-Horizon Self-Conditioning with Constraint-Adaptive Regularization for Latent World Models
result.summary: Planning with latent world models requires both accurate multi-step predictions and latent distances that reflect physical proximity to the goal. However, models are typically trained on ground-truth observations but must rely on their own imaginations during planning, while closer latent distances do not necessarily correspond to better task outcomes. Existing methods resort to auxiliary training objectives or additional task-cost readouts, which respectively incur extra training overhead or leave the latent geometry itself misaligned with task cost. We introduce CARE-WM, a drop-in training method that meets both requirements without additional supervision, a separate cost model, or any change to LeWM's architecture and Euclidean-cost planner. CARE-WM trains the predictor on its own predictions and adaptively calibrates the strength of latent regularization. With a single hyperparameter configuration, CARE-WM improves mean planning success over LeWM across all evaluated continuous-control tasks and matches or exceeds the best results of other LeWM-family methods on most tasks. Further analyses show lower open-loop latent prediction error and closer agreement between latent-cost rankings and physical task costs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CARE-WM：一种即插即用的 latent world model 训练方法，让预测器在同一 horizon 上以自身预测作条件训练，并自适应调节 latent 正则强度，在不改架构与欧氏代价 planner 的前提下改善多步预测与 latent 距离同任务代价的对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 「更近的 latent 距离未必对应更好任务结果」及用自身想象轨迹训练这两点，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 距离是否承载任务必要内容、以及轨迹训练带来的误差累积问题；但原文属连续控制世界模型，向视觉推理的迁移仅为可能线索。
